每个助手收到的都是同一个问题：“有多少比例的销售人员在第一次跟进之后就放弃？”五个助手给出的数字完全一样，只有 ChatGPT 表示，这个数字背后的证据并不明确。
One click in
谷歌 AI Overviews 引用的是某销售公司 2020 年的统计页面。数字就明明白白写在那里。而它的“来源”链接指向的是一篇写作范文。
Two clicks in

The end of the trail
线索到此为止。没有调查，没有样本，没有研究：我们尝试的通往这个数字的其他每条路径，都停在一个没有引用任何研究的页面上。这个数字至今仍在四处流传，底下却空无一物。这就是僵尸统计数字。

No survey, no sample, no date.
In the answer

Every assistant got the same question: “What percentage of salespeople give up after one follow-up?” All five assistants gave the same figure, and only ChatGPT said the evidence behind it was unclear.
One click in
Google AI Overviews cited a sales firm’s stats page, from 2020. The number is right there. Its “source” link goes to a writing sample.
Two clicks in
That leads to a freelance writer’s sample article, online by 2017. The number is in its headline. It lists two slide decks, a blog list and two news stories. None is a study of follow-ups.
The end of the trail

That’s where it ends. No survey, no sample, no study: every other route to this number we tried stopped at a page that cites no research. It’s a number still walking around with nothing underneath it. That’s a zombie stat.

blocks.text: Most numbers aren’t zombies. But you can’t tell from the answer: a zombie arrives with the same confidence and the same citation, and here, with all five assistants agreeing. So we did the same for 1,285 statistics.

blocks.text: What to do with an AI statistic.

inlines.text: What to do with an AI statistic.

blocks.text: Treat it as a lead, not a source. Six habits, three for each side of the citation.

inlines.text: Treat it as a lead, not a source. Six habits, three for each side of the citation.

blocks.text: If you use them

inlines.text: If you use them

blocks.text: Follow the citation, then follow it again.

inlines.text: Follow the citation, then follow it again.
If the cited page is a list of statistics or a company blog, use its own link to go one page further. Keep going until you reach the study itself, or until you can’t.

blocks.text: Check who was asked, how many, and when.

inlines.text: Check who was asked, how many, and when.
Most of the changes we found were in the context, not the digits: one country’s poll, a ten-year-old study, fifteen people.

blocks.text: Don’t take agreement as a check.

inlines.text: Don’t take agreement as a check.
Five assistants giving the same number isn’t five sources. The numbers they repeated most were no better sourced than the rest.

blocks.text: If you publish them

inlines.text: If you publish them

blocks.text: Put the method next to the number.

inlines.text: Put the method next to the number.
The sample, the date and a link to the source, on the same page as the figure, so the next page, and the next answer, can trace it back to you.

blocks.text: Keep the findings in the open.

inlines.text: Keep the findings in the open.
Reports behind a form were a common dead end: even trails that started at a research firm fell short 38% of the time. Put the headline numbers and the method on an open page.

blocks.text: See which page AI cites for your numbers.

inlines.text: See which page AI cites for your numbers.
It is often a roundup or a blog that copied you, sometimes with an older figure. That page decides what people hear.
